visual.general_description: Timeline arrow with nine text boxes describing the course from first ER admission to overall survival of 21 months.
visual.detailed_description: A rightward grey arrow with nine rounded boxes of printed text covering admission, blood counts, platelet infusion, chemotherapy, endocrine switch, second-line paclitaxel and overall survival.

panels.general_description: A grey horizontal arrow carrying nine rounded white text boxes that run from first admission to overall survival.
panels.detailed_description: A white background with a wide grey arrow pointing right. Nine rounded rectangles with black text sit along it: first admission in the ER Department with cough, back pain and dyspnea; first blood count with severe thrombocytopenia and anemia and a breast lump detected; treatment with antibiotics and platelet infusion with PLT 124 G/L; 1 week later PLT dropped by 43 G/L with a repeat platelet infusion and the first chemotherapy dose; 1 week later PLT increased by 62 G/L with Hgb increased; 3 weeks after the first chemotherapy dose PLT normal; 8 doses of chemo finished then a switch to anastrozol; after 14 months second-line paclitaxel; overall survival 21 months. There is a gap in the arrow between the sixth and seventh boxes.
